dedupe_keys.name: national environmental agency of georgia hydrometeorological data and design services

description: The National Environmental Agency of Georgia offers hydrometeorological data and services. The services page lists current and historical hydrometeorological data for Georgia; statistical parameters of long hydrometeorological series and complex climate characteristics; construction climate services based on long-term data; the delineation and mapping of areas expected to flood for 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 year return periods; short, medium and long-range general and special forecasts; warnings of hydrometeorological hazards and special forecasts for avalanche-prone sites; design of hydrotechnical structures for marine infrastructure and forecasts of sea and river bank dynamics; and hydrological and meteorological measurements and station installation. The page links Government of Georgia resolution 502 and its annexes, which set out the services for daily observations, generalised hydrometeorology, climatology, percentage probability, forecasts, continuous data supply, expedition hydrology, the coastal zone and station installation. Access is on request under that resolution; the cost of each service was not read and no licence is stated. Caveats: the page is in Georgian, and data is supplied as a service, not published openly. Coverage is Georgia. It supports hazard exposure and design of roads, bridges, ports, dams and buildings for floods, avalanches, coastal erosion and climate loads; related records are the IMN Costa Rica climate atlas and stations and the Cyprus Department of Meteorology climatology.
